scripts.e2e:workspace: npm run e2e:workspace:guest && npm run e2e:workspace:fake && npm run e2e:workspace:member && npm run e2e:workspace:quota
scripts.e2e:workspace:guest: node tests/e2e/run.mjs workspace-empty workspace-messages workspace-composer workspace-analysis workspace-result workspace-conversations
scripts.e2e:capabilities: npm run e2e:capabilities:offline && npm run e2e:capabilities:demo

scripts.e2e:landing: npm run e2e:landing:guest && npm run e2e:landing:member
scripts.e2e:run2: npm run e2e:capabilities && npm run e2e:landing && npm run e2e:map && npm run e2e:library && npm run e2e:result

scripts.e2e:dark: npm run e2e:dark:guest && npm run e2e:dark:operator
scripts.e2e:dark:operator: E2E_DEV_ROLE=operator E2E_SETTINGS=1 E2E_LLM=fake node tests/e2e/run.mjs dark
scripts.e2e:run3: npm run e2e:run3:guest && npm run e2e:run3:fake && npm run e2e:run3:quota && npm run e2e:run3:signin
